We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany!

This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gain valuable exposure to driving efficient operations at scale. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team.
  • Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures.

  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus

  • A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.

SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

data.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Please submit your application in English

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches for German sites, mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar). When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives in German and English through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Market access & prequalification support: Support the technical work needed for assets to enter ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and to meet Redispatch 3.0 requirements. With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.)

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include German grid connection rules and TSO-specific requirements, ancillary services, Redispatch 3.0, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the Gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get Gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and software deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing of sites with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Hardware handling & dispatch: Berlin is planned as our stock base for our hardware going out to sites across Europe, so the role includes some hands-on work. This covers preparing units before they ship, such as flashing and configuring our industrial PCs and running pre-shipment tests, and helping to prepare and coordinate shipments.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning, initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand in Germany and other parts of Europe grows. Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties, but occasional hands-on support in Germany may be needed before or after a deployment.

  • Incidents & support: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, needed for technical documentation and for working with customers, grid operators and our UK-based team.

  • Understanding of the German connection landscape: Working knowledge of the TSO/DSO hierarchy, the connection/integration process, and the technical connection rules (such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120) a grid-connected asset must meet before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the German energy markets: Working understanding of the German ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR), what prequalification involves, and the Redispatch 3.0 framework.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Hands-on hardware preparation: Comfortable working at the bench with our panels and industrial PCs. This includes safely powering panels up and down using our test setup, flashing operating system images, and following a set procedure for pre-shipment checks. Full training is provided.

  • Industrial communication protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, diagrams and tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with a team that is partly based in another country.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Location and travel: Ideally based close to Kraken’s Berlin office. Willingness to travel to customers and sites in Germany, and occasionally to our Manchester team, although travel is kept to a minimum. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of German grid compliance (VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, TSO-specific technical requirements) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany.

data.description:
Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us!

👋 About the Role

We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features.

This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly.

You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it.

What you will do

  • Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment.

  • Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need.

  • Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers.

  • Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans.

  • Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it.

  • Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable.

  • Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language.

  • Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security.

How we work

These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements.

  • Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach.

  • Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services.

  • Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected.

  • Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus.

  • Strong frontend expertise: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and a modern component framework (Vue 3 / Nuxt preferred).

  • Product and UX sense: A track record of designing clean, functional interfaces and delivering features without dedicated PMs or designers.

  • Data-driven mindset: Hands-on experience setting up and using analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar).

  • Daily use of AI coding agents: Active experience with agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot), a clear method for guiding them, and a clear method for checking what they produce.

  • Testing and review habits: Experience with automated E2E and UI testing (Playwright, Cypress, Vitest), the ability to define a testing strategy, and the discipline to review code, yours and others', before it merges.

  • Clear communication: Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable presenting ideas to non-technical stakeholders and working through written proposals.

Strong plus

  • Domain background: Prior experience in fintech, Web3 / digital assets or data-driven products.

  • Design systems: Experience building or maintaining a component library.

  • Backend / BFF capability: Experience building APIs and BFF layers, ideally with PHP / Laravel.

  • Cloud and DevOps: Practical experience with AWS environments, deployments and observability.

  • AI tooling workflow: Experience creating agent skills or CI guardrails for AI-assisted development.

Our stack

TypeScript · Vue 3 · Nuxt · PHP · Laravel · AWS · AI-assisted development workflows

Benefits

  • Offsites with the team in exciting locations

  • Flexible working hours in a company that relies on remote work

  • Exciting product in a very dynamic market environment as well as founding-level ownership of a key growth function.

  • Values-based start-up culture

  • Many opportunities to develop further and network with committed people

  • Flat hierarchy

We're a hybrid company building our core development team in Europe around Central European Time. The goal is to establish a hub around Munich, Germany.

Let’s build the next layer of trust for digital assets - together!

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in der Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- und Elektrotechnik sowie der Gebäudeautomation. Dabei sind unsere Projekte so vielfältig wie unser Team: Ob Forschungs- und Laborgebäude, Gesundheitseinrichtungen, Wohnungsbau, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäude oder komplexe Industrieanlagen – wir entwickeln technische Lösungen für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen.

Was uns antreibt? Technik sinnvoll einsetzen, statt sie unnötig kompliziert zu machen. Wir legen Wert auf durchdachte, wirtschaftliche und energieeffiziente Lösungen und verfolgen dabei einen klaren Grundsatz: So viel Technik wie nötig, so wenig wie möglich.

Als unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro setzen wir auf fachliche Kompetenz, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander. Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was wir gemeinsam erreichen, sondern ganz besonders auch, wie wir miteinander arbeiten!

Deine Aufgaben - hier gestaltest du mit:

  • Du bringst unsere Planungen in die Praxis: Als Bauleiter (m/w/d) begleitest du anspruchsvolle Projekte der Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten funktionierende Anlagen werden.

  • Du hältst auf der Baustelle die Fäden zusammen: Du koordinierst die beteiligten Gewerke, stimmst dich direkt mit Bauherren, Architekten und ausführenden Unternehmen ab und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen für die Herausforderungen im Baualltag.

  • Du behältst den Überblick: Qualität, Termine und Kosten hast du im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte fachgerecht und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du weißt, wovon du sprichst: Ob Ingenieur, Techniker oder Meister – du hast eine passende Qualifikation im Bereich der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung und kennst dich mit Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik aus.

  • Du kennst das Baustellenleben: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Bauleitung oder Objektüberwachung mit, weißt, worauf es bei der Umsetzung ankommt, und findest auch dann Lösungen, wenn es mal nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und vertrittst deine Standpunkte mit fachlicher Kompetenz und einem sicheren Auftreten – ohne dabei das partnerschaftliche Miteinander aus den Augen zu verlieren.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Wir finden, dass gute Arbeit auch ein gutes Arbeitsumfeld verdient. Deshalb setzen wir auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und ein Miteinander, bei dem sich alle wohlfühlen können.

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu deinem Leben passt: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice geben dir den Freiraum, den du brauchst.

  • Gut ausgestattet und mobil: Firmenwagen, Smartphone und Laptop gehören ebenso dazu wie die Möglichkeit zum Bike-Leasing und Zuschüsse für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Fortbildungen, gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch und die Erfahrung deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Wohlfühlen statt Kleiderordnung: Bei uns zählt, was du kannst, nicht was du trägst. Dich erwarten ein barrierefreies Büro, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks. Auch vierbeinige Begleiter sind willkommen.

  • Mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Mit Fitnessangeboten, Mitarbeitervorteilen und gemeinsamen Teamevents sorgen wir dafür, dass auch abseits der Projekte etwas geboten wird.

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Kurze Wege, offene Türen, ein unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander und Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, gehören bei uns einfach dazu.

Deine Erfahrung ist uns etwas wert!

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 60.000 und 85.000 € brutto – abhängig von deiner Qualifikation, deiner Erfahrung und der Verantwortung, die du übernimmst. Was du mitbringst, zählt – und das soll sich auch in deinem Gehalt widerspiegeln.

Dein Start bei uns – gemeinsam von Anfang an!

Wir lassen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser springen. Du lernst unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere spannenden Projekte in Kiel und Umgebung kennen. Dabei stehen dir erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen zur Seite, die dich bei deinem Einstieg unterstützen.

Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine eigenen Baustellen und wirst Teil eines Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet.

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Kein Problem! Für uns zählen nicht nur Zeugnisse und Lebensläufe, sondern vor allem deine Erfahrung, deine Persönlichkeit und die Lust, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen. Wenn du glaubst, dass du zu uns passt, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.

What you'll do

  • Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
  • Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
  • Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
  • Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth.

About you
You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years.

What's next
If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply before: 31-Oct-2026
For questions about the role, please contact:
Richard ----- class="content-conclusion">

We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.  

Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.  

No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.

About Agentio

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We're on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever's CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world's largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they've been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes' Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025. Named to Inc.'s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the "On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business" category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

About the Engagement

Agentio is seeking an independent contractor to support our Creator Partnerships function on a fixed-term basis (3–6 months) as we start to grow the supply side of the creator pool, internationally. This is a scope-based engagement — you'll bring your own expertise to a defined set of deliverables.

You'll focus on building direct relationships with influential creators and the leaders at top talent management firms, and helping close partnerships in the creator marketplace.

Scope of Work

  • Build and manage a pipeline of prospective creator and management-firm relationships

  • Conduct outreach (email, LinkedIn, phone, referrals) to generate qualified conversations

  • Bring market knowledge of creator economics, management structures, and platform dynamics

  • Share front-line insights that inform Agentio's product and go-to-market thinking, as one input among others to inform our international expansion strategy

  • Organize IRL meetings, events, Agentio Dinner Series in the UK

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 4+ years of experience in outbound-heavy business development, sales, or partnerships at a high-growth company - SaaS, marketplace, tech, or platform within the creator economy

  • A demonstrated track record of building pipeline and closing partnerships independently

  • Active, hands-on use of AI tools for prospecting, personalization, and pipeline management

  • Comfort working autonomously against a defined scope, without day-to-day direction

  • Strong relationship-building skills with creators, managers, and executives

Nice to Have

  • Existing relationships in the creator economy, influencer marketing, or digital media

  • Experience working with management firms, agencies, or media companies

  • Background in high-volume prospecting (SDR/BDR) environments

Why Work With Agentio

You'll get access to some of the biggest names in media and entertainment, and a front-row seat to a fast-scaling marketplace at an inflection point — with the flexibility of an independent engagement rather than a fixed employment relationship.

Compensation: £20 – £45 per hour

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Behind Wayve’s embodied AI is the compute and data infrastructure that enables our ML engineers and researchers to train and run increasingly capable models. Our Compute Foundations team builds and operates the large-scale cloud infrastructure that makes this possible, spanning GPU compute, storage, workload scheduling and the platforms that support training and inference.

You’ll lead this London-based team through its next phase of growth, helping build and maintain a reliable, high-performance, multi-cloud and multi-region platform. The challenges go beyond provisioning resources: they include scheduling workloads across different GPU architectures, keeping valuable compute available, and moving data efficiently while managing costs.

You’ll lead a team working with state-of-the-art tooling to tackle infrastructure challenges found only at the world’s leading AI companies, building the platform that enables Wayve to develop its AI Driver.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

People leadership will be your first priority. You’ll coach and develop engineers, set clear expectations, manage performance. You’ll build technical leadership within the team, giving engineers the support and ownership they need to grow. You will guide the growth of the team through hiring and onboarding.

Alongside this, you will own project prioritisation and roadmap planning, aligning priorities and delivery plans with stakeholders across Wayve. Your goal is to maximise the impact of the team in alignment with the department and company objectives. You will provide visibility into the state of systems you own through clear KPIs and dashboards.

Leading a highly technical team, you’ll bring the technical judgement to guide complex infrastructure decisions and turn competing needs into a clear roadmap. Working with technical leads, partner teams and cloud providers, you’ll balance reliability, performance, capacity and cost, and help the team deliver sustainably.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and developing the team: Coach engineers through regular feedback and one-to-ones, manage performance, support career development and build a healthy, performant and accountable team.

  • Hiring and building technical leadership: Lead hiring and onboarding as the team expands, and develop technical leads who can take ownership of key areas of the platform.

  • Driving the roadmap and delivery: Translate training and inference needs into priorities, align commitments with available resources, and surface risks and dependencies early.

  • Scaling cloud compute: Guide the evolution and operation of a multi-cloud, multi-region training and inference platform, including the adoption of new compute architectures (Nvidia Hopper, Blackwell; Qualcomm).

  • Improving scheduling and availability: Oversee Kubernetes-based infrastructure and queuing and scheduling systems, enabling workloads to use the right resources across heterogeneous GPU environments.

  • Planning capacity and cost: Partner with stakeholders and cloud providers on compute and storage forecasts, accounting for resource lead times, performance requirements and cost trade-offs.

  • Ensuring efficient storage across clouds: Guide distributed storage and caching approaches that improve data access and reduce unnecessary duplication and cross-cloud transfer costs.

 

🙌 You should apply if

  • You have a strong track record of managing and developing an infrastructure, platform or distributed systems engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.

  • You have delivered through others, owning team priorities and balancing delivery with operational reliability and longer-term platform improvements.

  • You have substantial experience in Kubernetes and workload queuing and scheduling systems, such as Kueue or equivalent technologies.

  • You can reason about availability, capacity, performance and cost across complex cloud infrastructure, including the interaction between compute, storage and data movement.

  • You understand large-scale GPU compute infrastructure for machine learning training or inference and the operational challenges of scaling beyond small GPU deployments.

  • You can earn engineers’ trust through sound technical judgement without needing to be the team’s primary individual contributor. You have successfully delivered as an individual contributor in the past.

  • You communicate clearly with technical teams, stakeholders and external providers, and can turn ambiguous requirements into practical priorities.

  • You are able to work from our London office and lead a team based there.

The following experience would be useful but is not required:

  • Operating multi-cloud or multi-region platforms for large-scale AI workloads.

  • Introducing new GPU architectures or managing heterogeneous GPU fleets.

  • Distributed storage, caching and data-locality strategies for data-intensive workloads.

  • Capacity forecasting, cloud cost modelling and close collaboration with cloud infrastructure providers.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews: system design and hiring manager interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews: technical leadership, code review and people management

  • Final interview: leadership, mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Wayve is building embodied AI that can drive any vehicle, anywhere. Within Robot Software, the Platform Integration team brings together the software and interfaces that enable our AI Driver to operate on new development platforms.

The team owns early vehicle software integration, drive-by-wire and the vehicle facing software drivers. We work across software, hardware, controls and operations to bring up new vehicle variants, improve their reliability and establish repeatable processes for validation and handover.

As Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the engineers responsible for this work, shaping both the team’s technical direction and its development. Your team will help Wayve scale across vehicles and OEM programmes by building reusable software interfaces and making integration more predictable.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You’ll be accountable for the team’s delivery, engagement, resourcing, roadmap and performance. You’ll coach engineers, support their career development, lead hiring and build a team with clear ownership and high standards.

Working with the team, you’ll set direction across vehicle interfacing software and integration practices. You’ll help the team balance immediate programme needs with longer-term investments in architecture, tooling and reliability.

You’ll also coordinate dependencies across teams, make priorities and trade-offs clear, and resolve risks early. The role combines software engineering leadership with practical delivery and execution.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

Leading and developing engineers: Set clear expectations, run effective one-to-ones, provide regular feedback, manage performance and support career progression.

Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, develop the skills needed for future programmes and build a collaborative culture across locations.

Setting direction and priorities: Maintain the team’s mission, ownership boundaries and roadmap, balancing programme commitments with improvements that make future integrations easier.

Delivering new vehicle integrations: Lead planning and execution from early preparation and bench integration through vehicle bring-up, validation and handover. Secure the resources and cross-team support needed for delivery.

Owning vehicle-facing software: Guide the architecture and development of Vehicle Driver and drive-by-wire components, building robust interfaces that reduce bespoke changes for each vehicle variant.

Improving reliability and release quality: Establish measurable reliability targets, use field feedback to prioritise improvements, and build strong ownership of testing, releases and escalated issues. Invest in sustainable over the air updatable infrastructure.

Making integration repeatable: Develop playbooks, tooling, runbooks and knowledge-transfer practices so subsequent vehicles can be commissioned and supported independently.

Driving technical collaboration: Review designs and work closely with software, hardware, controls, safety and operations teams, as well as customers and suppliers where needed, to resolve integration challenges.

You have a strong track record of leading and developing software or systems engineering teams, including coaching, hiring, performance management and career development.

You have owned a team roadmap and delivered complex engineering programmes through others, managing priorities, resources, dependencies and technical risk.

You have practical experience developing and integrating embedded or robotics software in a physical product.

You can guide architectural decisions and review designs for software that interacts with hardware, balancing immediate delivery with maintainability and reuse.

You understand the challenges of bringing up new hardware and software platforms, including testing, fault diagnosis, validation and operational handover.

You build strong ownership of reliability and quality, using metrics and lessons from real-world operation to drive improvements.

You communicate clearly and can align teams with different priorities around shared technical outcomes.

Experience with automotive systems, drive-by-wire, CAN or automotive Ethernet, vehicle controls, or bench and hardware-in-the-loop testing is desirable.

The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes end to end: framing the problem, shaping the smallest version that moves it, shipping it in collaboration with other teams, and proving whether it landed with our clients.

We are currently scaling our Product offering so you’ll be joining an established team made up of product, insurance and technical experts to meet the demands of our growing client pipeline.

This opportunity would be ideal for a Senior Product Manager who has worked in a scale-up previously, and wants to take on genuinely challenging problems in specialty insurance. It is a client-facing role: you will spend real time with clients in the specialty insurance and reinsurance market, and you will need to hold a position when a client's request and the right product decision diverge. This is a true 'hands-on' role, going beyond traditional backlog management or delivery coordination. You will also help us sharpen how the product team operates as we grow.

Responsibilities

  • Work across discovery, delivery and optimisation: turn problems and opportunities into well-shaped work with a clear hypothesis, ship it, and improve what is already live. Set the standard for how this is done, so other product managers can learn from the work you produce.

  • Decide what to build next and what to stop. Design the research and measurement that will answer the question in front of you, and show the reasoning behind each decision.

  • Lead roadmap and delivery conversations with clients as a peer. Where a client's request and the right product decision diverge, hold the position and explain why.

  • Hold scope to the smallest version that still moves the outcome, working with cross-functional teams to ship iterative enhancements, and coach that same discipline across the teams you work with.

  • Own the roadmap for your client engagement and set its direction within company strategy. Agree priorities and timing with the VP of Product, and decide what to stop and why.

  • Own a product initiative across your client engagement from start to finish, including its milestones and how you will know it has succeeded.

  • Feed what you learn from your clients into our view of the target state for digital and connected insurance businesses.

First Three Months

In the early days of your role, you’ll be expected to focus on:

  • Building relationships across teams to support project success

  • Leading discussions with both internal and external stakeholders

  • Making sure everyone at Artificial is aligned on what is important

  • Delivering against our continuous roadmap, and starting to form a view on how we'll know they've landed well with customers

  • Forming direct relationships with external stakeholders

  • Gaining meaningful insight into our current processes and ways of working that could benefit from fresh eyes

  • Taking ownership of the work flowing through your area, and building the relationships and context needed to make the calls yourself.

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • 10+ years demonstrable experience working in the Product Manager or Product Owner space and delivering value to the business

  • Strategic thinker with a business mindset

  • Used to working in a fast-paced, technological environment, with all the ambiguities this presents: flexibility will be needed

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Come from an InsurTech or Insurance background

  • Previously worked in a scale-up environment

  • Worked with remote development teams

  • A preference for agile working and being involved across the full product lifecycle

  • An appetite for helping a product team sharpen its operating rhythm

  • Technical fluency, able to understand and contribute to technical discussions with engineering teams.

  • Sound judgement around feasibility, performance trade-offs with the ability to make smart product choices aligned with technology impact

People skills and behaviours

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Acting as the translator between insurance people and our engineers

    • You’ll reach a working understanding of the specialty insurance market within your first six months, enough to hold your own with clients who work in it every day. The learning journey is yours to own, but we will support you along the way.

  • Ability to communicate complex ideas using a clear, user friendly format

  • A real ‘do-er’ and builder - someone who loves being hands-on and getting things done

  • Happy to travel to client site (City of London) as needed

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

    As part of our hiring process, we’ll carry out some background checks. These may include a criminal record check, reviewing your credit history, speaking with previous employers and confirming your academic qualifications.

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an enterprising, dynamic and highly self-sufficient Counsel, International to join our fast-paced International Legal team.

In this role, you will be a key player supporting our European footprint with a primary focus on Germany, while also driving expansion into new European markets through our international launch function. Operating at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and e-commerce, you will tackle novel legal questions, bring clarity to complex regulatory frameworks, and partner closely with business leaders to build compliant, high-growth healthcare experiences across Europe.

You will be a central operational driver for our German and pan-European commercial, telehealth, and pharmacy strategy.

You Will:

  • Support German Operations: Serve as a key legal advisor on day-to-day matters across Germany advising on healthcare and pharmacy regulations, e-commerce compliance, digital health, and marketing.

  • First-Principles Problem Solving: Untangle complex, novel, or undefined regulatory challenges where traditional precedents don't exist. You will help build legal frameworks using first principles rather than off-the-shelf templates.

  • Deliver Actionable, Concise Advice: Cut through ambiguity and synthesise complex legal risks into clear, commercially pragmatic guidance. Your advice will be direct, risk-calibrated, and focused on business value.

  • Navigate Pharmacy & Healthcare Regs: Advise cross-functional teams on German, Dutch, and cross-European pharmacy regulations, telemedicine rules, prescribing workflows, healthcare compliance and privacy. Particular focus on Germany’s AMG and HWG.

  • Commercial Risk & Disputes: Mitigate commercial risk, negotiate key partner/vendor agreements, and assist with advertising and competition matters (including Germany’s unfair competition / UWG litigation environment).

  • Drive Market Expansion & Growth: Partner with the international launch team to scale existing operations and launch Hims & Hers into new European markets, navigating local regulatory, legal, and operational landscapes from scratch.

Who You Are:

  • Qualified Attorney: Admitted to practice in the UK, Germany, or Ireland (other EU jurisdictions considered by exception) with ~5+ years PQE in a top-tier law firm, tech company, or fast-growing digital health/telehealth business.

  • First-Principles Thinker: You thrive on novelty and ambiguity. When faced with a problem that has never been solved before, you dig into core principles to construct creative, compliant paths forward.

  • Pragmatic & Commercial: You balance legal requirements with real-world commercial pressure. You understand what the business values and can move quickly without sacrificing quality or compliance.

  • Exceptional Communicator: You get straight to the point accurately and efficiently. You can explain intricate healthcare or consumer laws to non-lawyers clearly and concisely.

  • Self-Sufficient Operator: You take ownership, run autonomously, and prioritise effectively in a high-velocity environment without needing hand-holding.

Nice to Have:

  • Domain Exposure: Prior experience navigating German and/or European pharmacy regulations, digital health/e-health laws, or Germany's unfair competition landscape is strongly favored. GDPR experience will also be viewed favourably, particularly in a healthcare context.

  • Language Skills: German

Nice to Have:

  • Preferred: Based in London with a hybrid work structure (time spent in our Old Street office collaborating with team members).

  • Flexible: We are also open to exceptional candidates based remotely in Ireland or Germany.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

WHOOP is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Trade Marketing, EU to join our team on a 12-month contract, providing maternity leave coverage for a key leadership position within our European retail business. As a senior leader within the regional commercial organization, you will oversee the planning, execution, and optimization of omnichannel trade marketing programs that strengthen the WHOOP brand, accelerate retail sell-through, and deepen relationships with strategic retail partners. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Brand Marketing, Market Management, Creative, and Operations to deliver a consistent, premium member experience across physical and digital retail environments. The ideal candidate brings strong commercial acumen, demonstrated people leadership, and deep knowledge of the European retail landscape, with the ability to quickly integrate into an established team, maintain momentum on critical initiatives, and balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution.

This is a 12-month contract position, with an hourly pay range of £40-£45/hr.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and develop a team of three trade marketing professionals, providing clear direction, coaching, prioritization, and accountability to ensure continued execution of regional priorities and business objectives.

  • Own the EU trade marketing strategy and execution across key retail partners and markets, overseeing integrated marketing plans, product launches, seasonal campaigns, in-store activations, and digital retail initiatives that drive brand awareness, consumer engagement, and sell-through.

  • Serve as a senior strategic partner to EU Sales leadership, key retail accounts, and cross-functional stakeholders, aligning trade marketing investments and initiatives with commercial priorities, retailer needs, and regional growth opportunities.

  • Oversee the development and deployment of high-impact retail marketing assets, including point-of-sale materials, merchandising displays, digital content, and retail associate training programs, ensuring consistent brand execution and effective localization across European markets.

  • Ensure business continuity and operational excellence throughout the contract period by maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, driving accountability against established plans, proactively resolving challenges, and supporting a seamless transition of responsibilities.

  • 8+ years of experience in trade marketing, retail marketing, channel marketing, or related commercial marketing functions, ideally within consumer technology, consumer electronics, premium lifestyle, or similarly fast-paced consumer brands.

  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, with the ability to provide effective leadership, establish priorities, and drive results within an existing organizational structure.

  • Strong understanding of the European retail landscape, including major retail partners, omnichannel marketing strategies, regional market dynamics, and localization requirements.

We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Staff Data Engineer

At Sparta, we're on a mission to build the next generation of commodity trading platforms - replacing the fragmented tools traders depend on with a single, powerful dashboard. Our product is a data-driven platform that aggregates real-time feeds from across the commodities domain, transforming them into intuitive, actionable visualisations within one unified interface. Users can explore pre-built data views or build their own custom formulas - turning raw market data into decisions.

At the heart of Sparta is a serious data engineering challenge. We're building a platform that enables the rapid development of reliable, scalable ETL pipelines - the foundation everything else depends on. As our data volumes grow and our product ambitions expand, the demands on that infrastructure grow with them. We're looking for experienced data engineers who are familiar with these challenges at scale — people who understand what it takes to keep a data platform performing as complexity increases.

We want people who thrive with ownership. At Sparta, you'll be handed problems, not solutions - and we expect you to run with them. Speed matters, autonomy is real, and we'd rather you move fast and course-correct than wait for permission. As a Staff engineer, you'll also be shaping the direction of the platform itself: engaging directly with stakeholders, contributing to product thinking, and investing meaningfully in the engineers around you.

This role can be based in the UK (London) or Spain (Barcelona, Madrid), and we would expect to spend some time together with the team in-office (2 -3 days a week).

Core Responsibilities

  • Play a leading role in the design, build, and ongoing evolution of scalable data pipelines and ETL frameworks that power both real-time and analytical data processing.

  • Take shared ownership of the health and performance of our data platform - optimising for latency, throughput, and reliability at scale.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data infrastructure aligns with product goals and trader-facing outcomes - acting as the connective tissue between data and backend engineering.

  • Drive architectural decisions across our data platform, with a focus on pipeline reliability, data quality, and scalability.

  • Contribute to the definition of our target architecture - shaping how we ingest, transform, store, and serve data as the platform evolves.

  • Mentor and support other engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on knowledge sharing.

Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience as a data or software engineer, with a strong track record of delivering production-quality data systems.

  • 2+ years working within a product-focused organisation, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Proven experience building and scaling data-intensive pipelines and platforms in production environments.

  • Deep understanding of stream and batch processing frameworks - hands-on experience with Flink or Spark is essential.

  • Comfortable working across multiple programming languages - we primarily work with Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript.

  • Equally comfortable designing high-level architecture as diving deep into low-level implementation details.

  • Experienced in designing and deploying data infrastructure in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP.

  • Hands-on experience with core data infrastructure tooling such as Kafka, Redis, and/or clustered Postgres.

Nice to have experience

  • Familiarity with open lakehouse technologies, such as Apache Iceberg and dbt.

  • Experience building data infrastructure to support AI agents - including low-latency retrieval and analytical interfaces.

  • Experience leading teams or managing engineers, driving both delivery and technical excellence.

  • Exposure to complex distributed environments with demanding constraints such as high throughput, low latency, or large-scale datasets.

Working style

Whereas Sparta is a remote-first company, for this role we’re looking for someone who values a hybrid working style, which in a typical week could involve spending a couple of days in the office - with flexibility built in.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

CRM at LemFi doesn't run on batch and blast. As Senior CRM Manager - Automations, you'll own the lifecycle journeys that carry a customer from first sign-up to their tenth product, across remittance, credit, savings and the insurance products coming next. This is the person who builds onboarding, retention, reactivation, referral and cross-sell journeys that adapt to real customer behaviour, not a calendar.

What you’ll build and own

  • Design and own the lifecycle journeys, onboarding, retention, reactivation, that run without you touching them daily.

  • Build referral and virality programmes that turn customers into the acquisition channel.
