  • Test, measure and iterate. Kill what doesn't move the number, scale what does.

Your experience

  • Comfortable with SQL and event-based data models. You query the data behind your own journeys.

  • Language skills in French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Wolof or Swahili.

  • Experience with WhatsApp or SMS as a lifecycle channel.

  • Background in remittance, cross-border payments or diaspora-focused products.

  • Experience designing loyalty or points-based programmes, beyond straight referral.

  • Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-sensitive comms environment.


Why Join LemFi?

Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.

Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.

Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.


Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.

LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.

You like building things as you go and you move toward ambiguity. You want high impact and fast pace.

We recently released Encord Data Labs: our research arm through which we'll be sharing some of the lessons learned from our internal research on how data actually moves model performance in the physical world.

We're looking for our first Research Communications Lead, to build and drive our Data Labs research and publishing motion. You won't just be on the author list, you'll be identifying interesting problems and topics to explore, and working with the rest of our ML team to shape their results into research that helps progress our field.

A taste of what Data Labs has worked on and published in its first months:

  • EMG-1: we released the largest open dataset of wrist EMG synced with egocentric video: 307 hours of real work captured on head and wrist cameras, plus a 10.4-hour lab set with optical mocap, over 30x larger than the next public dataset of its kind

  • EMG + vision fusion: by adding muscle signals to camera-based hand tracking, we were able to reduce median fingertip error by ~25%, and ~35% when hands were briefly occluded

  • Encord-REACH: we built a video-native 3D hand pose model for egocentric work scenes, now in production with robotics teams; it cuts wrist tracking error by 80% and joint error by 65%, is 30–70% more accurate on industrial gloves, and almost never swaps in a bystander's hand

  • Synthetic data for ANYbotics: using NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory to turn 410 reference images of industrial sites into 1,500+ short clips, we lifted ANYbotics' inspection anomaly recall by 24%, for ~$55 of generation

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Marshmallow makes insurance work for everyone, including people the industry has overlooked. Your difference makes the difference, and we design for it.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our Telematics team. Telematics is a key part of Marshmallow’s future that sits within Acquisition and how we grow our user base.

In a nutshell, you’ll help more people get onboarded into Marshmallow by reducing friction in our sign up and activation flow. Longer term, you’ll be part of the team that build customer stickiness by working out how to reward and engage customers for being good drivers. You’ll work with a team that will back you up, and you’ll own problems from day one.

What you’ll be doing

  • Starting with the problem. You’ll shape what we’re solving by doing research with customers, spotting patterns, and turning what you hear into clear themes and needs the team can act on.

  • Designing the whole journey. Wireframes, prototypes, flow to polished screens. You’ll be translating complex concepts into clear, benefit-led experiences. You’ll be thinking about the content on the screen and edge cases too. It’s primarily customer facing, web and app but if your work touches our internal tools, you’ll be thinking about that too.

  • Letting data point the way. You’ll use funnel and analytics data to find where customers get stuck and where we could be causing harm. Then you’ll work with your team to fix it.

  • Building with engineers. You’ll work alongside them from the first idea to what’s shipped. Clear specs and smooth handoffs. If a design tweak is quicker to ship yourself, you can raise the PR.

  • Working in a cross-functional team. Product managers, engineers, operations, data and other designers. You’ll continuously challenge and learn from each other.

  • Bringing stakeholders with you. Acquisition gets a lot of attention here. You’ll form your own opinions, explain your thinking, and keep people in the loop. You won’t be doing it alone, and we’ll help you build the skill.

  • Looking after the design system. Contribute to it, keep things consistent with our brand, and flag anything that doesn’t fit so we can sort it.

  • Using AI every day. For research, analysis and production. Try tools, keep what works, and share it with the team.

You should apply if

  • You have a commercial instinct. You have good gut instinct on what makes a product work and a portfolio that backs up what you’ve shipped having good business impact.

  • You have a proactive mind-set. You look to make continuous improvement to the products that you are working on. You find issues and features, write up tickets and ship them when they’re ready.

  • You are actively using AI. You’ve used AI to optimise your workflow and create efficiency gains whether that’s building prototypes, shipping to production, analysing data or conducting research.

  • You prefer to ship quickly and learn. We like to move quickly and learn from real data. This means being able to spot when good is good enough and iterating.

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

You will manage end-to-end complex employee casework, drive continuous improvement across HR processes, refine key employment policies, and collaborate closely with our Compliance and Risk teams to support our firm’s enhanced regulatory status.

We're looking for an Employee Relations Consultant to join Marshmallow's People team for an initial three-month engagement, with the possibility of extending to six months depending on caseload. We're open to either a fixed-term contract or a day-rate consultancy arrangement.

What you'll be doing

  • Leading complex UK ER cases, assessing risk and judging when or if external legal advice is needed.

  • Embedding practical procedures that turn our updated policies into consistent day-to-day ways of working.

  • Strengthening case documentation and storage across locations so records are accessible to the right people and ready for audit.

  • Delivering targeted manager training informed by casework patterns to build confidence and prevent escalation.

  • Partnering with People Partners and the Hungarian People team on case handling, consistent processes and FCA standards.

Your expertise

  • Experience independently managing complex UK employee relations cases, backed by a strong working knowledge of UK employment law.

  • Experience developing ER policies and procedures, embedding them in an organisation and helping managers use them.

  • Experience designing and delivering manager training that helps prevent recurring issues and unnecessary escalation.

  • An understanding of ER in a regulated environment, including how FCA standards affect employee conduct and case handling.

You don't need a background in tech. We're more interested in the complexity of the cases you've handled and your ability to combine casework, process improvement and manager support.

Who you are

  • You weigh legal and business risks pragmatically and explain your recommendations clearly.

  • You constructively challenge senior stakeholders and external advisers when a different approach is warranted.

  • You get up to speed quickly, prioritise a changing caseload and collaborate closely with a lean People team.

  • You use AI thoughtfully in ER work, with appropriate confidentiality safeguards and human judgement.

Our process

  1. An initial call with Orla from our Talent team for 45 minutes about your experience and approach to the role.

  2. An interview with our Head of People and our Lead People Partner for 90 mins, including scenario-based questions about case handling, risk and stakeholder challenge.

We review every application and will always let you know the outcome, though we're unable to provide individual feedback at application stage.

Diversity of thought

About the team

The OpenAI Startups team helps founders build and scale products with AI. We combine technical understanding, commercial judgement and startup ecosystem relationships to help customers move from promising ideas to building and scaling their businesses with OpenAI.

About the role

You will lead one of our EMEA Greenfield sales teams, helping high-potential startups choose OpenAI, reach production and establish the foundations for growth. Greenfield covers two distinct motions: Early Stage, focused on activation and meaningful expansion, and Pursuits, focused on high-stakes conversion of the startups with highest potential and new customers with complex buying decisions.

You will translate regional strategy into clear account priorities, hire and develop Account Directors, and coach the customer and commercial work appropriate to the team you lead. You will work closely with technical partners and VC Partnerships to turn founder access and technical engagement into customer value, qualified pipeline and consumption revenue.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week.

In this role, you'll:

  • Recruit, onboard and develop a strong team of Account Directors. Set clear expectations, coach live customer work, sales methodology and deal strategy, as well as giving direct, actionable feedback.

  • Build and execute the Greenfield GTM strategy and sales plan for your team. Prioritise companies using customer need, workload, decision timing, founder and funding signals, commercial potential and available technical capacity.

  • Coach the motion your sellers own. For Early Stage, strengthen discovery, activation, first production use and initial growth. For Pursuits, strengthen competitive strategy, executive access, evaluation, migration planning and negotiation.

  • Create a disciplined pipeline and consumption forecasting rhythm. Connect opportunity stages and revenue expectations to customer evidence, production milestones and specific next decisions.

  • Build trusted relationships with founders, technical leaders and commercial decision-makers. Help the team explain how OpenAI can improve product quality, delivery speed and economics for the customer’s workload.

  • Partner with VC Partnerships, Marketing and developer-facing teams on qualified sourcing and activation. Match direct sales effort, nurture and scaled engagement to customer intent and potential.

  • Align with Solutions and AI Engineering on technical scope, evaluation criteria and support capacity. Bring in Product, Deal Desk, Legal and other partners when their expertise can advance the customer’s decision.

  • Turn technical success into a credible commercial path and sustained paid adoption. Use approved programmes and commercial processes, and ensure customer commitments reflect a realistic production and consumption plan.

  • Build reusable discovery guides, sales plays, competitive playbooks and migration plans. Route routine billing, credits and support requests to the right channels while retaining clear ownership of material customer blockers.

  • Coordinate account transitions with Core and strategic coverage. Preserve customer context, relationships and the next growth plan, and keep ownership clear until a handoff is accepted.

We're seeking someone with experience including:

  • Six or more years leading sales teams, including hiring, developing and managing technical sellers in fast-changing markets.

  • Working closely with startups as a founder, early employee or commercial leader serving startup customers.

  • Selling platform or software products in a product-led or consumption-based business, with a record of converting technical adoption into revenue.

  • Leading the relevant Greenfield motion: scalable early-stage acquisition and activation, or complex competitive pursuits and production migrations.

  • Building repeatable sales processes while preserving judgement about customer fit, account priority and the right level of support.

  • Coaching both technical and commercial discovery, qualifying opportunities and managing evidence-based forecasts.

  • Discussing AI applications, APIs, model evaluation and production economics credibly with founders and technical leaders, while drawing on specialist expertise when needed.

  • Working across technical, product, marketing, operational and commercial teams, and translating customer learning into better products and programmes.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • You understand founder urgency, earn trust through useful advice and communicate candidly about what is possible. You need to be comfortable with ambiguity and creating clarity and direction in an ever-changing landscape and priorities. You are curious about AI, comfortable with ambiguity and willing to learn quickly. You enjoy developing sellers and building systems that make a growing team more effective.

What success looks like:

Your team reaches the right startups early, advances customers into meaningful production use and builds a healthy path to customer value and growth. Qualified pursuits progress through clear technical and commercial decisions. Sellers become more capable, forecasts become more reliable, and the team scales its reach through repeatable programmes and effective handoffs.

requirements and performance.

  • Ensure statistical rigor and clear decision-making from experiments

  • Make experimentation a consistent driver of website performance

  • Support new product launches with self-sign-up journeys

  • Prepare the website for international expansion

  • Coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies, and handle competing priorities

  • Own tracking plan and conversion data quality

  • Align Growth and Data teams on trusted metrics and reporting

  • Deep understanding of experimentation and A/B testing methodologies

You will work with experimentation, tracking, and analytics tools such as AB Tasty, GA4, GTM, and Amplitude and use AI to boost squad operations and execution.

  • Ownership of a strategic website attracting over 450,000 visits per month

  • Direct and measurable impact on demo bookings, self-sign-ups, and company growth

  • Opportunity to structure and grow a multidisciplinary Website squad

  • Key role in scaling Pennylane’s culture of experimentation

  • High-visibility projects across brand, product, and international expansion

  • Close collaboration with Growth, Product, Engineering, Sales, Data, and Brand teams

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

data.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

 
 

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Your impact

Great growth decisions start with reliable data.

At Pennylane, we're building the financial operating system for European businesses. As we grow and expand into new markets, understanding how users discover, interact with and adopt our product is becoming increasingly important.

That's where Growth Engineering comes in.

We're looking for a Growth Engineer with strong data and tracking expertise to help us build reliable, scalable tracking and analytics foundations across our digital acquisition journeys.

You'll join our Growth Engineering team and work closely with Thomas, our Growth Engineering Team Lead, within the Marketing Website squad.

Your mission ? Make sure we collect the right data, trust what we measure and turn insights into better growth decisions.

What you'll do

Build reliable tracking foundations

You'll own the technical implementation and reliability of tracking across our website and acquisition funnels.

  • Design, implement and maintain tracking plans across key user journeys.

  • Build and improve event tracking, user identification and data collection.

  • Work with tools such as Segment, Amplitude and Google Tag Manager.

  • Ensure tracking consistency, accuracy and reliability across our digital ecosystem.

  • Identify and resolve tracking issues before they impact business decisions.

Connect data across our growth ecosystem

You'll help build the technical connections between our website, internal systems and analytics tools.

  • Develop and maintain APIs and integrations between platforms.

  • Ensure reliable data flows between our acquisition, product and analytics tools.

  • Collaborate with Data teams to improve data quality and consistency.

  • Support the evolution of our tracking architecture as Pennylane scales internationally.

Power experimentation and conversion

You'll work closely with Growth, Marketing and Data teams to understand user behavior and improve acquisition performance.

  • Implement the technical foundations for A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Help measure acquisition funnels and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Ensure experiments are properly tracked and measurable.

  • Translate business questions into clear technical tracking requirements.

  • Support data-driven decisions through reliable instrumentation.

Contribute as an engineer

This is an engineering role, not a reporting or dashboarding position.

You'll be expected to bring strong technical fundamentals and take ownership of your work.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • Build scalable and reliable technical solutions.

  • Investigate complex tracking and data issues.

  • Improve existing systems, processes and documentation.

  • Collaborate with engineers across Growth, Engineering and Data teams.

  • Contribute to technical decisions and engineering best practices.

Who are you?

We're looking for an engineer who understands both how data is collected and why it matters.

Someone who enjoys solving technical problems, working with different teams and making sure that business decisions are based on data people can trust.

You don't need to be a data scientist or a marketing specialist. But you should be comfortable working at the intersection of software engineering, analytics and growth.

We'd love to meet you if...

  • You have a software engineering experience, with hands-on exposure to tracking, analytics or data integrations.

  • You have implemented and maintained event tracking across websites, applications or acquisition funnels.

  • You're fluent in AI-assisted development : you work with coding agents, create custom skills and instructions, use worktrees to parallelize work and keep code quality high.

  • You're familiar with tools such as Segment, Amplitude, Google Tag Manager or similar platforms.

  • You understand event schemas, data layers, user identification and tracking consistency.

  • You're comfortable working with JavaScript and APIs to implement and troubleshoot tracking.

  • You care about code quality, reliability and maintainability.

  • You enjoy taking ownership of technical projects, from design to production.

  • You're comfortable working in French and English.

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Ruby on Rails, Vue.js or Nuxt.js.

  • SQL and data warehouses.

  • Server-side tracking and conversion APIs.

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms.

  • Attribution, conversion measurement or acquisition analytics.

  • Privacy-conscious tracking and consent management.

  • International websites and multi-market acquisition funnels.

Our technical environment

Our Growth Engineering team works with:

  • Frontend: JavaScript, Vue.js, Nuxt.js

  • Backend: Ruby on Rails

  • Database: PostgreSQL

  • Development: Git, GitHub

  • Analytics & Tracking: Segment, Amplitude and other analytics tools, depending on the project

You'll collaborate closely with our Data teams and contribute to the evolution of our growth tracking infrastructure.

Why you'll love this role

  • Real impact: Your work will help teams understand how users discover and adopt Pennylane.

  • Technical ownership: You'll contribute to the architecture and reliability of our tracking ecosystem.

  • Engineering standards: You'll work on technical challenges that require the same level of rigor as our other engineering teams.

  • Cross-functional exposure: You'll collaborate with Growth, Marketing, Engineering and Data.

  • International scale: You'll help build the data foundations needed to support our expansion across Europe.

  • Continuous improvement: You'll have room to challenge existing implementations, propose better solutions and improve how we measure growth.

If you enjoy building reliable data foundations and want to see your engineering work directly influence growth decisions, we'd love to meet you.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We’re building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn’t just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

Who we are looking for

Everyone at Higgsfield is an A-player. We're looking for teammates who bring:

  • High energy, strong commercial instincts, and flawless execution.

  • Ownership and accountability to drive deals end-to-end.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships with partners, agencies, and enterprise clients.

  • Resilience in high-pressure situations and an always-on mindset.

  • A balance of sharp analytical skills and natural people intuition.

  • Hunger to win and the grit to scale a B2B SaaS business globally.

About the role

This is the GTM Account Executive role for Europe. You will be our first dedicated seller for the region, responsible for turning Europe's agencies, brands, production companies and media groups into Higgsfield customers: sourcing and closing the first European deals yourself and owning the accounts after signature. You work with our Almaty-based GTM team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

What you will work on

  • End-to-end sales execution: identify, pitch, negotiate, and close deals with European agencies, brands and B2B partners, from first touch through signature.

  • Open the market: build a named-account plan for Europe and work it, starting with advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers.

  • Convert platform demand: turn high-usage European creators, teams and agencies already on Higgsfield into team and enterprise accounts.

  • Account management: own relationships post-sale, ensuring adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

  • Partner routes to market: identify and activate European agencies, production studios and resellers that bring us customers we would not reach one deal at a time.

  • Customer success: act as the voice of the European customer internally, ensuring feedback flows into product and engineering.

  • Processes at scale: build the repeatable playbook that the next European hires will follow.

Your must haves

(You don't need to meet every single requirement to be a strong candidate. If you're excellent in a few of these areas and eager to grow, we'd still love to hear from you.)

  • Revenue track record: demonstrable history of consistently achieving and exceeding multi-million dollar revenue targets, with deals you sourced and closed yourself.

  • Proven experience in B2B SaaS sales and/or account management with measurable results.

  • Experience selling into advertising agencies, brand marketing organisations, or media and entertainment companies in at least two European markets.

  • An existing network of senior buyers in European agencies, brands or media groups.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. A second major European language is a strong plus.

  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and closing skills.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage sales data and metrics for decision-making.

  • Ability to work in a high-growth startup environment.

Nice to haves

  • Big3/Big4 consulting experience or equivalent top-tier professional background is a strong plus.

  • Experience selling AI, GenAI, or ML products.

  • Experience in early-stage, fast-scaling startups.

  • Exposure to upselling, cross-selling, and customer success strategies.

  • Relationships in European broadcasters, streamers or sports media.

  • Existing network of enterprise clients or partners in SaaS/AI ecosystems.

The deal

  • Competitive base salary in USD.

  • Equity participation through the company's stock option program.

  • Based in Almaty (on-site; we sponsor and process your work permit, cover your flights, and provide temporary housing while you settle in) or remote in Europe, with regular travel across the region and to Almaty.

  • Our GTM team works six days a week and overlaps with US hours. Expect the same pace wherever you are based.

  • Full-time position.

  • Opportunity to become the cornerstone of Higgsfield's European sales engine.

Qui sommes-nous ? 

Q ENERGY France est un acteur majeur du marché des énergies renouvelables en France. Autrefois affilié au groupe RES, l’entreprise œuvre depuis 27 ans dans le développement, la construction et l’exploitation de projets éoliens et photovoltaïques.  

 

Aujourd'hui également positionnée sur le marché du stockage d'énergie, Q ENERGY poursuit son expansion vers de nouveaux domaines afin de proposer des solutions intelligentes et complètes pour la production et la fourniture d’énergie durable en France. 

 

L'entreprise compte près de 300 collaborateur.rice.s et 6 agences sur le territoire ainsi qu'un siège social basé à Avignon. Q ENERGY France est une entreprise de la holding européenne Q ENERGY Solutions, créée en 2021 par Hanwha Solutions dans l'objectif de conduire à la prochaine génération de production d'énergie verte et flexible en Europe. Basée à Berlin, Q ENERGY Solutions est une société sœur de Q CELLS, fabricant de modules photovoltaïques reconnu à travers le monde. Les deux sociétés constituent la division Energie du groupe Hanwha Solutions, basé à Séoul. 

 

Vos missions : 

Vous serez support au pilotage et à l'animation d'études d'impacts sur l'environnement de parcs éoliens et centrales solaires comprenant notamment le volet naturel, le volet paysager et des études spécifiques.  

Vous serez en lien avec l'équipe projet, les autorités et les spécialistes pour identifier et traiter l'ensemble des risques environnementaux des projets. 

Vous participerez à la concertation de tous les acteurs permettant de réaliser la conception de projets la plus adaptée au territoire.  

Vous proposerez des axes d'amélioration sur les mesures E-R-C-A (Eviter, Réduire, Compenser, Accompagner) des projets éoliens et solaires. 

En particulier les axes d'amélioration suivants ont été identifiés :  

  • Amélioration du bilan carbone des projets (outils, méthodologies) et proposition de mesures de réduction de l’impact carbone des projets. 
  • Amélioration de la gestion des risques dans les projets solaires développés en SIS (sites et sols pollués). 
  • Amélioration de la synergie entre projets solaires et stockage batterie-BESS (projets d’hybridation). 

Vous participerez au dépôt des dossiers de demande de permis de construire et à leurs instructions (Commission CDPENAF, Enquête Publique, Réponse avis MRAe,...). 

Vous aurez l'occasion de suivre la mise en place concrète de mesures environnementales en phase chantier/construction sur une centrale solaire. 

HSE : 

Contribution à la culture Santé, Sécurité et Environnement de l’entreprise via :  

  • Réalisation du travail dans le respect des mesures de prévention mises en place au sein de l’entreprise et reprises notamment dans le Document Unique, les Politiques Santé, Sécurité et Environnement, procédures, modes opératoires et guides 
  • Déclaration de tout événement ou situation pouvant représenter un danger pour les personnes y compris collègues et prestataires et/ou l’environnement  
  • Participation aux événements de formations et de sensibilisations traitant de ces thématiques 

Qualité : 

  • Respect et mise en œuvre de la politique d’entreprise et des procédures qualité  
  • Participation à la mise à jour des documents du système de management de la qualité  
  • Déclaration des non-conformités et participation à la mise en place d’actions correctives 
  • Participation aux actions et projets d’amélioration continue et de partage des savoirs

Requirements

Votre profil : 

  •  Vous préparez un bac + 5 dans une formation d’ingénieur.e en environnement, agriculture, agronomie ou un Master en Ecologie, Biodiversité, Développement Durable 
  • Vous utilisez quotidienne le pack office et êtes à l’aise dans l’utilisation des outils informatiques d’une manière générale. 
  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, curieux.se et force de propositions. Vous savez évoluer en autonomie dans vos recherches. Vous êtes doté.e d’un excellent relationnel.   

 

Localisation et déplacements 

Durée : 6 mois  

Localisation : Nantes - déplacements ponctuels en Bretagne / Pays de la Loire / Centre Val de Loire 

Benefits

Comment faisons-nous la différence ? 

  • Des valeurs fortes et incarnées   
  • Un management de proximité   
  • Une dynamique d’organisation apprenante   
  • Une entreprise en constant développement  
  • Valorisation et développement des compétences   

Nos avantages sociaux 

  • Flexibilité et bien-être : jusqu'à 1 jour de télétravail et flexibilité des horaires 
  • Prise en charge à 100% des frais de transports collectifs  
  • Forfait mobilité durable pour les déplacements en mobilité douce (vélo...) ou en covoiturage et aides à l’écomobilité   
  • Titres restaurants (10€ pris en charge à hauteur de 5,5€ par la société)   
  • Activités et évènements régulièrement proposés par le CSE   

 

Nous concourrons à créer un environnement professionnel fondé sur le respect, l'inclusion et la bienveillance, en réunissant des personnes d'horizons différents pour qu'elles nous apportent des idées novatrices et de nouvelles perspectives. 

Convaincu.e.s que la diversité est une richesse, nous veillons à offrir un processus de recrutement accessible et équitable. A compétences égales, toutes les candidatures sont étudiées avec la même attention. Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement lors du recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part, notre référente handicap pourra vous accompagner en toute confidentialité.

lemlist is a global B2B SaaS business with the mission to help any business grow.

  • Bootstrapped

  • Personal Branding with Taplio & Tweet Hunter, generating $4M ARR

lemlist is a highly ambitious company that aims to become a world-class giant in the Sales Tech space.

Our mantra: Keep growing – and we live by it every day.

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack TypeScript Developer to join our team. You'll be responsible for designing and developing new features for our SaaS products. We need someone who is passionate, autonomous, and loves technical challenges.

Your main missions will be:

  • Design and develop new features from scratch, both on the frontend and backend, Independently developing new features that enhance user experience and increase product functionality.

  • Stepping into the role of technical lead within your squad, driving excellence and setting standards.

  • Improve the code base with refactoring, bug fixes, and optimization

  • Work on multiple projects simultaneously

  • Help the customer support team on technical issues, providing prompt and effective solutions

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing and capacity building by training fellow developers, enhancing overall team competency and productivity.

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

  • Successfully onboarded and integrated into the team

  • Developed a deep understanding of our B2B SaaS products and their technical requirements

  • Contributed to the development of new features and improvements to our existing code base

Within 12 months you will have

  • Played a key role in the development and delivery of multiple successful projects

  • Made significant contributions to the optimization and scalability of our software products

What’s in it for you?

  • Work in a profitable, bootstrapped, and high-growth company that doesn’t rely on external funding to live.

  • You will have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on a suite of products that are changing the game in multiple industries.

  • Work with passionate senior engineers who share their knowledge and expertise

  • Great ownership of your work. You will be part of a dynamic, innovative, and passionate team that respects autonomy and encourages individual input.

  • No endless meetings

  • Full remote policy

  • You will grow professionally and personally, enhancing your technical skills and expanding your global network.

Preferred Experience

Must have

  • You’re an expert in TypeScript / JavaScript with at least 7 years of XP

  • You have a proven track record in building and maintaining web applications.

  • You have a robust understanding of NodeJS and MongoDB, and ideally React

  • You’re able to work independently and take ownership of complex projects

  • You’re a fast learner

  • You’re comfortable with the agile methodologies

  • You like to communicate

  • You like to work remotely, Gather, Slack and Notion are your best friends

  • You are adaptable and like to discover new things and you can work on front-end integration, back-end development, mongo optimization, performance issues and more

  • You speak French and English and you are in the French timezone

Nice to have

  • You have a first experience in B2B SaaS startup

  • You are self-taught, you have been developing personal projects since you were a child or in the evenings and weekends. This is not mandatory but a big plus for us, we are all passionate about programming and like to create things, both at work and outside

Additional Information

  • Salary between 65K€ and 75K€ fixed salary

  • Profit sharing: When lempire wins, all team members share the profits

  • Where you live, and work is totally up to you – we do have an office in Paris if you enjoy life at the office 🇫🇷

  • Swile Meal Tickets: Enjoy daily meal tickets to fuel productivity

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat.

What You'll Do

Payroll and contractors

  • Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation.

  • Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees.

  • Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies.

  • Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file.

  • Reconcile each cycle to catch what doesn't add up before it’s live.

People operations and HR admin

  • Manage employment documents for a team spread across France, the US, and remote.

  • Administer benefits: enrollments, changes, and the questions employees bring.

  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly.

Employee support

  • Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions.

  • Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs.

  • Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law.

Systems and projects

  • Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it.

  • Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts.

  • Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers.

  • Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved.

  • Experience with an HRIS.

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool.

  • Exposure to international or EOR payroll.

  • Comfort building automations to cut manual work.

  • Experience at a scale-up.

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

For candidates in France, the base pay range for this role is €45k–€65k, plus variable. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐

Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris.

Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here.

You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan.

⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐

Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you.

  • Governance, risk and compliance: ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management

  • Vulnerability management: triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling

  • Detection and response: write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents

  • Build: technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Past projects: an internal pentest for an audit, code scanning and remediation, an HDS internal audit, tooling proofs of concept

  • Automate what repeats, so the team spends its time where the risk is

⭐ KEY OUTCOMES ⭐

By the end of the internship, you will have:

  • Owned a recurring security campaign end to end and left it cheaper for the next round

  • Shipped one technical project to real users

  • Written your end-of-studies thesis on a real security subject

  • Worked with engineers and senior people across the company

⭐ PROFILE & COMPETENCIES ⭐

  • End of studies: engineering or security track, looking for a six-month internship

  • Security foundations: solid basics in security and IT, and you can apply them to a concrete case

  • You code: Python at least, and you automate the repetitive part

  • Curiosity: you dig into topics you don't master yet, and you are curious about compliance, not only offensive security

  • Risk sense: you know not every risk is equal, and some trade-offs are worth taking

  • Collaboration: you work with engineers, not against them, and look for solutions that work for both sides

  • Clear communication: structured and written, in English (French is a plus)

  • Bonus: CTFs, personal security projects, a previous security internship, cloud or SaaS experience

🙌 Perks & Benefits


At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.
Therefore, we offer:

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

     

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever-changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo.

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ The insurance controller role ⭐️

Our insurance scope is growing fast: more complex reinsurance treaties, prévoyance (disability and death cover) moving in-house, new products and markets. At the same time, Finance is taking over the Solvency 2 balance sheet, which will be audited from 2028.

We’re looking for a rigorous, ownership-driven insurance finance professional to own our prévoyance technical flows and the production of the Solvency 2 balance sheet. You’ll join the Financial Controlling team (within Financial Reporting) and act as the hub between Risk, Actuarial, Ops, Data and Strategy, as well as the main contact for our reinsurers and external auditors.

You’ll know these numbers inside out: how they’re produced, what business reality they reflect, and how to defend them to auditors, the ACPR and the Board. You read the source texts yourself (accounting rules, Solvency 2 regulation, treaty clauses), form your own view, and know when to escalate.

⭐️ What you will do ⭐️

  • Prévoyance flows: own premiums, claims, technical provisions (mathematical and claims reserves) and related reinsurance, from P&L through balance sheet and cash

  • Reinsurance accounting: manage reinsurance accounts, quarterly settlements and profit-sharing clauses, making sure the books reflect what our treaties actually say

  • Solvency 2 balance sheet (solo and group): restate French GAAP to Solvency 2, challenge actuarial best estimates and risk margin, and track own funds quarter to quarter

  • Regulatory reporting: prepare balance sheet and own-funds QRTs and write the balance-sheet section of the SFCR

  • Audit readiness: be the single point of contact for auditors on Solvency 2, starting with the 2027 dry run, with documentation and controls always ready

  • Monthly review: analyse and comment on your scope (P&L, balance sheet, variances, loss ratio and other insurance KPIs)

  • Automation: turn manual computations into clear specs for our Finance Data team, and use data and AI to make closing faster and more reliable

  • Business partnering: flag the accounting and solvency impact of new products, treaties or markets early and follow through to implementation

⭐️ What we’re looking for ⭐️

  • At least 5 years in insurance accounting, ideally Big 4 insurance audit followed by finance or reporting at an insurer

  • Strong command of French GAAP insurance accounting (technical provisions, reinsurance, insurance P&L)

  • Hands-on experience with the Solvency 2 balance sheet and QRTs

  • Strong analytical skills: reconciling large datasets, bridging French GAAP to Solvency 2, spotting inconsistencies; comfortable with SQL and AI tools

  • Organised, rigorous and comfortable building structure from ambiguity; you close the loops and can explain technical topics to actuaries, auditors and non-finance stakeholders alike

  • Fluent in English and French

Big pluses: prévoyance experience (long-term reserves, mortality/disability tables, profit-sharing), having built a Solvency 2 production process, actuarial knowledge, IFRS 17.

🌍 How we work

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Nous sommes aujourd’hui une cinquantaine de salariés et nous visons 10 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2027, ce qui nous placera parmi les leaders du marché. Le cap derrière : que tout client qui veut s'équiper pense à nous en premier, parce que nous sommes la référence sur la qualité de l'accompagnement et des produits que nous vendons.

Pour tenir ce cap, nous nous structurons en trois BU :

  • Notre réseau de Partenaires Certifiés, pour accompagner les clients sur des travaux que nous ne proposons pas en propre (vente et pose de pompe à chaleur notamment).

  • Le matériel, afin de lancer sur le marché français les produits fabriqués par le groupe, comme sa pompe à chaleur Cosy, que l’on souhaite proposer à nos Partenaires Certifiés. 

Guillaume, Directeur Général Délégué, qui a lancé la filiale, supervisera les trois et cherche la personne qui dirigera la BU Solaire, notre activité historique.

Ta mission :

Tu diriges la BU Solaire comme un·e véritable dirigeant·e de business : tu fixes le cap, tu portes les résultats et tu construis l'organisation qui nous fera passer à l'échelle. Ton premier chantier : monter en cadence de pose, sans dégrader la qualité, tout en améliorant la rentabilité de la BU en 2027. Tu le fais depuis le terrain autant que depuis le bureau.

Tes responsabilités seront les suivantes : 


1. Stratégique : Définir le cap et faire grandir la BU.

Tu portes la vision, la stratégie de développement de la BU et tu prends les arbitrages structurants, notamment :

  • Fixer la trajectoire de la BU et trancher les décisions qui font avancer le business ;

  • Décider, le moment venu, des extensions : nouvelle zone géographique, nouvelle ligne de produit ;

  • Représenter la BU en interne et faire l'interface avec Octopus Energy France (fourniture d'énergie, offre bundlée pose + contrat + pilotage batterie), les fonctions support partagées et les deux autres BU.

  • Suivre la rentabilité à chaque maillon de la chaîne (vente, étude, pose, SAV) et les faire suivre à chaque manager ;

  • Travailler avec eux à les améliorer : coût d'acquisition, délais de pose, SAV ;

  • Produire les chiffres du reporting groupe et savoir les défendre.


    • 3. Managériale et opérationnelle : Faire grandir les managers et structurer l'organisation.

    Tu fais monter les responsables de chaque équipe pour qu’ils portent la montée en cadence de la BU dans une organisation qui grandit : 

  • Accompagner les managers d’équipe au quotidien pour qu'ils·elles fassent grandir ses équipes, y compris dans les moments difficiles ;

  • Structurer, avec les équipes techniques, la montée en cadence de pose ;

  • Animer le collectif et incarner la culture de l'entreprise : exigence de qualité, jalons, victoires célébrées.


    • Ce qu'on cherche :

    Ce qui compte d'abord, c'est qui tu es : 

  • Tu t’intéresses vraiment aux gens, tu es exigeant·e et tu dis les choses clairement, dans le respect de la personne en face.

  • Tu sais engager des équipes pluridisciplinaires : commerce, administratif, technique et terrain ne parlent pas la même langue, tu fais le lien.

  • Tu accompagnes tes managers pour qu'ils fassent monter leurs propres équipes.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans une entreprise en construction : on teste, on se trompe, on recommence.

  • Tu prends ton sujet en main et tu as le courage managérial de dire les choses.

  • Tu es proactif·ve, tu trouves des solutions en autonomie et tu fais s'activer les équipes autour de toi.

    • Côté compétences techniques :

  • Tu as déjà dirigé une activité opérationnelle avec des équipes de terrain. Le solaire résidentiel n'est pas obligatoire.

  • Tu lis un P&L et tu défends tes chiffres devant une direction.

  • Tu as une vraie vision business : tu relies l'opérationnel à la rentabilité.

  • Tu es prêt·e à aller sur le terrain, régulièrement.

  • Tu sais communiquer (écrit et oral) en anglais pour échanger avec le Groupe. 

    • Conditions :

  • Contrat : CDI – Statut Cadre

  • Localisation : Paris ou Lille (déplacements à prévoir entre les deux bureaux et sur le terrain)

  • Date de prise de poste : Dès que possible

    •  

    Processus de recrutement :

    1. Premier échange avec Chloé, notre Talent Partner en charge de ce recrutement 

    2. Échange visio de 30 min avec Guillaume pour comprendre tes motivations pour le poste 

    3. Entretien en présentiel à Paris ou Lille avec Guillaume et potentiellement un échange avec un des membres du COMEX Octopus France

    Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

    Tu veux connaitre le salaire ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. 🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the Long-Term Platform Tech Strategy: Define the 2–3 year technical vision and roadmap for Malt's engineering platform — backend, frontend — alongside platform leads, ensuring architectural consistency, security, and high reliability across all engineering squads. Agentic capabilities are a central pillar of that vision, not a side project.

  • Architect Platform Foundations: Partner closely with Backend, Frontend, and SRE leads to design and build our company-wide platform foundations — from core shared infrastructure through to our agentic layer, consolidating existing POCs into unified, enterprise-grade capabilities.

  • Pioneer Agentic DevEx Workflows: Prototype, scale, and embed autonomous AI agents into the software development lifecycle (e.g., agentic MR reviews, automated code quality, and security fixes) so product teams can focus strictly on core product logic.

  • Deliver Platform-as-a-Product: Provide product engineers with self-service tools, reusable components, clear guardrails, and documentation making both our platform foundations and our autonomous workflows the natural, default way to ship software at Malt.

  • Build, Hands-On: Contribute directly to the platform. You'll write production code on the systems you design: the hardest parts, the reference implementations, the things nobody else can unblock.

  • Raise the Bar: Drive the adoption of best practices, coding standards, and high-quality engineering processes, including thorough code and architecture reviews. Foster operational excellence across the platform.

  • Mentor and Coach: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across the platform team, particularly Senior and mid-level engineers, helping them develop their skills, master agentic patterns, and advance their careers.

  • Drive Technical Alignment & Change Management: Act as a technical catalyst, influencing and aligning backend, frontend, and engineering leads around transformative AI agent paradigms without relying on top-down authority.


    • About you

  • Technical Expertise: You have 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering, including a proven track record operating at a Staff or Principal level in high-scale platform environments. You're highly proficient in Kotlin or Java, comfortable across GCP and modern web frameworks (e.g. Nuxt/VueJS), and at ease navigating complex backend architecture, APIs, and data models.

  • AI-Driven Innovator: Passionate about AI topics, you regularly keep up to date with the latest developments. You have already built product-grade agentic workflows within the software development lifecycle: systems engineers rely on daily to review, test, or ship code, not demos or POCs.

  • Clear leadership: You excel at working effectively in uncertain and evolving environments, managing the interaction between technical objectives and business priorities.

  • Platform as a Product Mindset: You think beyond the code. Your product is the developer experience: you're curious about the "why" behind the workflows, core components you build, proactive in proposing improvements, and you own delivery from A to Z: including the adoption, not just the architecture.

  • Resourceful: You always find a way of getting things done, even under severe staffing constraints.

  • Impactful: You demonstrate excellent ownership and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of agency in driving solutions.

  • Strong interpersonal abilities: You possess excellent written and oral communication skills in English (French is a valuable bonus).


    • How to join the mission?

    1. Initial Screening Call (45m): First exchange with Luke Singh or Alexandre Hidasi (Tech & Product Recruiters) to explore your background, career aspirations, and answer any initial questions.

    2. Manager Interview (60m): Deep dive into your technical background, domain experience, and alignment with Anaïs Ghelfi (Hiring Manager & Engineering Director).

    3. Technical Business Case & Debrief (2h): Practical architecture exercise and debrief with Staff Engineers to evaluate your systems design and agentic architecture mastery.

    4. Executive & Culture Fit Interview (2h): Final conversation with Claire (CTO) to discuss Malt’s long-term vision, followed by an informal coffee chat with Raphaël Ouazana & Pierre Reynaud.

    Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫

    - Remote work: Hybrid policy balancing on-site and home office

We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
